title: Showcase-navigation maps are current, hide only, and keep the account and search entries of Diner WP and Morgan WP
steps: S1: Run node scripts/build-joomla-showcase-nav.mjs --check and node scripts/build-wordpress-showcase-nav.mjs --check.

S2: Read every showcase-nav-map.json under packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/contracts and packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-quickstart/contracts; list operations whose op is not one of menuItem.param, module.published, templateStyle.megaSubRemove, templateStyle.megaColumnRemove, navigation.removeLink, templatePart.setNavigationRef, templatePart.removeBlock, and menuItem.param operations that do not set menu_show to "0" from "1" or unset.

S3: In the ja-diner/wp7/1.0.1 and ja-morgan/wp7/1.1.16 maps, read the labels of navigation.removeLink operations and whether any templatePart.setNavigationRef or templatePart.removeBlock operation exists; check a removeLink targets the drawer navigation (Diner 278, Morgan 160).
S4: In the ja-smallbiz/j6/1.0.4 map, check for a templateStyle.megaColumnRemove operation.

S5: Run node --test on packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/joomla-contract-bind.test.mjs, wordpress-quickstart.test.mjs and joomla-contract-fetch.test.mjs; read the test names for a showcase phase whose apply or revert is lost or refused, a half-applied phase, a started phase with a missing token or a malformed or missing receipt: provisioning continues with one "!! showcase navigation:" line and the receipt settled failed; an inspect that no longer confirms after the revert stays fatal.
expect: S2: at least 40 maps found; no operation listed.
S3: neither map removes Login or Smart Search; neither repoints or removes a header drawer; each removes at least one link inside its drawer navigation.
evidence: Before this change a customer install kept the template's demo navigation; an earlier map of Diner WP and Morgan WP swapped or removed the drawer holding the real Login and Smart Search pages
fence: Static read of the committed maps plus the builders' own staleness check; plugin behaviour is covered by the claude-cowork suites and real-stand runs
